metadata.desc: Snapshot-driven autonomous QQ group agent with tool-only external actions and XML delta-block group context.

authorized_group_ids.description: QQ groups allowed to run the agent
authorized_group_ids.hint: Leave empty to disable autonomous runs. Add QQ group IDs as strings; * enables every group.

max_context_tokens.hint: Uses AstrBot Core's token counter. The latest observation block drops its oldest records first when it alone exceeds the budget; older records remain searchable through history tools.

max_log_records.description: Maximum pending/inflight Buffer records per group
max_log_records.hint: 0 disables the Buffer capacity limit; acknowledged message bodies are deleted.

max_text_chars.description: Maximum stored text length per message

record_self_messages.description: Record messages sent by the bot account
record_self_messages.hint: Enabled bot echo events can enter later snapshots and start another reasoning cycle.

record_empty_messages.description: Legacy compatibility flag for contentless-event diagnostics
record_empty_messages.hint: Contentless transport events are never written to the SQLite Buffer or sent to the model.

custom_system_prompt.description: Additional persona or group behavior instructions
